name: showmehow.eth
summary: showmehow.eth, how-to guides on IPFS sites and ENS, built with Eleventy. It stays at Level 2: one post loads Twitter's widgets.js from platform.twitter.com with no integrity hash, and no public source of the site was found (its search script is a minified Pagefind file with no source map). Other pages load only the site's own files.
